settings.text: A bold, action-oriented headline goes here.

This frame is designed to be used with a "cutout" style image with a transparent background (webp is best). For best results, make sure the image is cropped as closely to the subject as possible, both horizontally and vertically.

Traditionally our industry has used Lorem Ipsum, which is placeholder text written in Latin. Unfortunately, not everyone is familiar with Lorem Ipsum and that can lead to confusion. I can’t tell you how many times clients have asked me why their website is in another language!
